§3 gives the native/formal body without collapsing formal neighbours into proofs of the authored ontology. Its governing centre is **[A18](../arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) Primordial Symbolon and Its Eight Determinations**, supported by [A11](../arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md)/[A12](../arguments/A12-Mono-Poly-One-All-Whole-Many.md)/[A13](../arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md)/[A14](../arguments/A14-Computational-Process-Ontology.md)/[A15](../arguments/A15-Ratio-Rationality-Measure-Reckoning-Harmony-Account.md)/[A16](../arguments/A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field.md)/[A17](../arguments/A17-Toroidal-Circulation-and-the-Arche-Topos.md) and articulated through [C11](../arguments/concepts/C11-Quaternal-Logic.md) QL, [C20](../arguments/concepts/C20-Arche-Topos.md) Arche-Topos, [C49](../arguments/concepts/C49-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) Two Ones, [C50](../arguments/concepts/C50-Dia-Syn.md) Dia/Syn, [C52](../arguments/concepts/C52-Dimensional-Reframing-at-Zero-and-Infinity.md) dimensional reframing and [C61](../arguments/concepts/C61-Symbolon-Disclosure-Architecture.md) disclosure architecture.

The exact [A18](../arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) traversal is one continuous relation:

`−/−, 0/1, ?/!, −/+, X/x, AM/IS, ∞/dx, 1/0`.

It is not eight detachable topics and is not the definition of QL as a whole. Relational Form Growth is also locked: `N / N′ → N+N′` generates earned relations between conjugates; `N → N×N` is a distinct distributive recursion; `3:3` and `4:2` remain orienting readings.
